Israeli strike on the Iranian consulate annex in Damascus
First direct Iranian missile and drone attack on Israel
Israeli strike near Isfahan
Iranian ballistic missile attack on Israel
Israeli strikes on Iranian military sites
Twelve-Day War: Israeli strikes on Iranian nuclear and military sites, Iranian missile response, ceasefire
US strikes on Iranian nuclear sites

2026 Iran war begins: US (Operation Epic Fury) and Israeli (Operation Roaring Lion) strikes; Supreme Leader Ali Khamenei killed; Iran answers the same day (Operation True Promise IV) against Israel and Gulf states
US naval blockade of shipping from Iranian ports after the Islamabad talks fail
Ceasefire collapses after attacks on commercial ships in the Strait of Hormuz; the memorandum formally expires in August

note: Base is the last close before the event date; day k is the k-th trading close on or after it. US-listed stocks are shown against SPY. 'Unusual' means the average move is at least 2.0 standard errors from zero given the asset's normal swing, with 3 or more events. Events on the same date count once. Some events fall inside each other's 5- and 20-day windows, which overstates certainty. 'Without largest' drops the single biggest move to show whether one event carries the average. A few events, so treat every number as a hint. Not a trading signal.
